notes: Cancelled prepared-drive auto-start timers whenever a Rip Node disconnects, so reconnecting cannot start a rip using an expired 15-second hold.
Prepared Drive opens an empty tray only when that drive supports Open / Eject.
After manual tray closing and positive disc detection, Manager waits silently for 15 seconds before starting; it never auto-closes the tray and shows no countdown.
Per-drive Supports Open / Eject and Supports Close capability settings remain available under Hardware → Drives.
Failed, cancelled and completed jobs detach after eject so replacement physical and simulated discs start cleanly as Disc detected.
Bundled Rip Node API remains v0.2.5.
